thresholds.name: flood_rise_pct
thresholds.note: The snapshot calls river discharge 'rising' when the last forecast day is more than 10% above the first (services/engine/snapshot.py). NOT from a source; review pending.

thresholds.name: humid_rh_pct_min

thresholds.name: mild_temp_c_range
